component.name: Katten
component.summary: Unofficial Mistral Vibe client for KDE Plasma

description.p: Katten is a Qt-native desktop application for KDE Plasma that lets you chat with Mistral AI's Vibe using your own API key. It is fully themed by your Plasma settings and shows the full conversation, not just single answers.

ul.li: Full multi-turn conversations, kept locally and continued on Mistral's servers
Rich-text responses: bold, italic, lists, tables, code blocks, hyperlinks and charts
Optional web search through Mistral's built-in web_search tool
API key stored securely in KWallet, never in plain text
Optional KRunner plugin (separate package) to send prompts from Alt+Space

description.p: Katten is unofficial and not affiliated with Mistral AI. Using the Mistral API requires an API key from console.mistral.ai and may incur costs.
